info.name: Anvil Backend - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Anvil Backend API following CTO methodology.

**Methodology Applied:**
- Problem Decomposition: Organized by functional domains (Public, User, Admin)
- Solution Generation: Modular structure with reusable variables and scripts
- Risk Assessment: Comprehensive test coverage and error handling

**Features:**
- 200+ endpoints organized in 30+ modules
- Automatic authentication flow
- Pre-request scripts for dynamic data
- Test scripts for validation
- Environment variables support
- Multi-language support (en, es, pt, zh)
- Rate limiting awareness
- Error handling examples

item.name: 0. Setup & Authentication
item.description: Initial setup and authentication flows. Run these first to obtain tokens.

request.description: Check API health status. No authentication required.
Register a new user account. Returns access_token and refresh_token.
Login with email and password. Returns JWT tokens.
Login with Privy Web3 authentication. Requires Privy token from frontend.
Refresh access token using refresh token.
Get current authenticated user profile. Requires authentication.

item.name: 1. Public Endpoints
item.description: Public endpoints that don't require authentication.

request.description: Send a message as guest user. IP-based tracking. Rate limited: 20 msgs/hour.
Get chat history for current guest session (IP-based).
Get guest status including rate limit information.
Get available chat shortcuts for quick actions. Multi-language support.
Confirm password reset with token from email.
Create a new conversation. Returns conversation ID.
Send message with unified routing. Automatically routes to GraphRAG, Agent Squad, Supervisor, or regular chat based on intent detection.
Get messages from a conversation with pagination.
Execute a swap action. Two-step flow: simulate → confirm → execute. Set confirmed=true after user approval.
Execute a deposit to a lending protocol. Requires confirmation.
Execute a token transfer. Requires confirmation.
GraphRAG hybrid search for DeFi protocols. Combines semantic and graph search.
Find similar protocols using graph analysis.
Send message to specific Agent Squad agent.
List all enabled agents for current user (filtered by subscription tier).
Get all wallets for current user.
Sync wallets from frontend (Privy embedded wallets).
Export wallet private key encrypted with HPKE. Requires public key for encryption.
Get token balances for user wallets.
